scope: Current-source clusters left provisional by true-Claude workers without live search
verification_rule: A current claim is resolved only against the paper page, official product documentation, or the owning project's repository. This ledger is independent of Claude identity coverage.

claims: Comfy Cloud submits with POST /api/prompt and returns prompt_id.
The Cloud API is experimental and version-sensitive.
It cascades a lightweight pointer network with 6 Transformer layers.
Detected boxes and classes are ordered by the pointer-network stage.
The paper defines four post-processing subtasks.
It reports 30K generated examples and Qwen3-VL-4B fine-tuning.
It introduces dynamic chunking with overlap-based synchronization and a document tree.
AniMatrix defines Style, Motion, Camera, and VFX production variables and dual-channel conditioning.
AniMatrix artifacts were still described as preparing for public release, so the article does not claim reproducibility.
The LTX-2 trainer supports LoRA, full fine-tuning, and IC-LoRA.
The LTX-2 dataset guide documents scene splitting, caption review, resolution buckets, latent caching, and decode verification.
FLUX.2 unifies generation and editing and supports up to 10 references in the documented family boundary.
The official overview distinguishes API, playground, dev, and klein reference limits.
FLUX.2 klein has 4B and 9B variants; 4B is Apache 2.0 and is described at about 13GB VRAM, while 9B uses the FLUX non-commercial license.
